summary: Cyberduck 9.6 adds AWS Console sign-in for S3, Microsoft Entra ID sign-in for Azure, ProxyCommand support for SFTP and checksum checks on uploads to S3, Google Drive, Dropbox and more. The OneDrive Shared folder is gone. Overwriting a file over SFTP no longer appends to it, and on Windows, Pageant now works through the OpenSSH agent pipe set in ssh_config.
